headword: {預|あず}け{入|い}れ{荷物|にもつ}

definitions.explanation: Luggage that is handed over at the airline check-in counter to be loaded into the aircraft's cargo hold, as opposed to carry-on baggage.

examples.japanese: {預|あず}け{入|い}れ{荷物|にもつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧です。
examples.english: You can check up to two bags for free.

examples.japanese: {預|あず}け{入|い}れ{荷物|にもつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重量|じゅうりょう}→重量：05475_juuryou⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えて→超える：01942_koeru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I exceeded the weight limit for checked baggage.

examples.japanese: LCC⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧{預|あず}け{入|い}れ{荷物|にもつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{有料|ゆうりょう}→有料：03178_yuuryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{機内|きない}{持|も}ち{込|こ}み→機内持ち込み：10204_kinaimochikomi⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{済|す}ませる→済む：01950_sumu⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Since checked baggage is often paid on budget airlines, I try to manage with just carry-on.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{預|あず}け{入|い}れ→預け入れ：15910_azukeire⟧ (depositing/checking in) + ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧ (luggage/baggage). This is the standard airline term for luggage checked into the cargo hold.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {預|あず}け{入|い}れ{荷物|にもつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧: checked baggage restrictions
- {預|あず}け{入|い}れ{荷物|にもつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{有料|ゆうりょう}→有料：03178_yuuryou⟧: checked baggage is paid
- {預|あず}け{入|い}れ{荷物|にもつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to pick up checked baggage
- {預|あず}け{入|い}れ{荷物|にもつ}⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦{枠|わく}→枠：13100_waku⟧: free checked baggage allowance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {受託|じゅたく}⟦{手荷物|てにもつ}→手荷物：09928_tenimotsu⟧: checked baggage — a more formal synonym used in official airline documents
- ⟦{機内|きない}{持|も}ち{込|こ}み→機内持ち込み：10204_kinaimochikomi⟧⟦{手荷物|てにもつ}→手荷物：09928_tenimotsu⟧: carry-on baggage — luggage taken into the cabin
- ⟦{手荷物|てにもつ}→手荷物：09928_tenimotsu⟧: hand luggage — can refer to either carry-on or baggage in general

USAGE:
With the rise of LCC (⟦{格安|かくやす}{航空|こうくう}{会社|がいしゃ}→格安航空会社：18968_kakuyasukoukuugaisha⟧), awareness of checked baggage fees has increased among Japanese travelers.
